# StruXure

> > StruXure manufactures Pergola X, a smart motorized pergola system with app-controlled louvered roofs, Alexa integration, and customizable designs for luxury outdoor living spaces.

StruXure is headquartered in Muncie, IN and offers AI-driven outdoor structures through a nationwide dealer network. The company specializes in smartphone-controlled patio solutions with smart louver technology for weather protection and year-round outdoor enjoyment.

## Key Topics

- Pergola X
- Motorized pergolas
- Smart louver technology
- Smartphone-controlled outdoor living
- Alexa integration
- Weather protection
- Luxury outdoor living
- Patio covers
- Residential and commercial installations
- Dealer network
- 3D visualizer tool
- App integration
- Customizable pergola designs
